For the record, Wikia's main sidebar is pretty cool:

 * navigation
 ** mainpage|mainpage
 ** listwikis-url|listwikis
 ** recentchanges-url|recentchanges
 ** randompage-url|randompage
 ** randomcategory-url|randomcategory
 
 * community
 ** portal-url|portal
 ** mailinglists-url|mailinglists
 ** featuredwiki-url|featuredwiki
 
 * help
 ** helppage|help
 ** problemreport-url|problemreport
 ** irc-url|irc

Awww, there's no longer 7 spokes ;P. I'm a little tempted to take the mailing list off, but that would probably seal its fate. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 10:16, 19 September 2006 (UTC)

==Links==
The headers cannot be linked in the same format as their contents. "mainpage|a wheel of time", "mainpage|top content", "portal-url|community", and "Category:Cleanup|Jump Right In!" should have the section to the left of the pipe removed as they show up verbatim on the sidebar, and it looks pretty weird.
